messages:
dario: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on capacity: can someone clarify the planned regional headroom numbers and how prewarm interacts with eviction?

sam_infra: TL;DR: target headroom = 18% in primary regions (us-west-2, eu-west-1) Q3, implemented as a mix of reserved + prewarm. Prewarm nodes default to reserved semantics unless flagged preemptible.

noa_product: On the UI side we need to expose: headroom %, prewarm toggle (preemptible=true/false), and a regional fallback latency slider.

ravi_ops: Autoscaler behaviour: local -> model-variant (quantized) -> cross-region (if latency penalty <= configured threshold). Default threshold = 150ms. We'll emit an alert when cross-region fallback occurs.

zoe_support: For CS: how do we label incidents? It should be obvious if a user hit a model swap vs region reroute.

sam_infra: We'll tag events as fallback_type=(variant|cross_region) and fallback_signal=(capacity|latency). Also adding metrics: fallback.count and fallback.latency_penalty_ms.

scale_bot: autoscaler: prewarm scale +3 us-west-2 (scheduled spike)

dario: Pricing/policy: if customers opt into preemptible prewarm, do they pay less and accept higher eviction risk?

noa_product: Proposal: prewarm-hourly pilot = 45% of reserved hourly rate for preemptible prewarm. Non-preemptible prewarm billed as 85% of reserved. Putting this to finance for approval.

ravi_ops: Mechanically, preemptible prewarm nodes get a taint and an eviction weight of 0. That makes them lowest priority for retention. Non-preemptible prewarm weight = 1.

zoe_support: I'll draft short support copy: "We may transparently swap to a quantized model or route to a fallback region; if your workload requires strict in-region serving, enable 'pin to region' in Dedicated settings."

sam_infra: Action items: Sam to write short eviction spec + labels; Noa to add console design mock and pricing blurb; Zoe to prepare CS FAQ; Ravi to wire alerts. Target: drafts by next Wed EOD.

dario: Thanks team — please paste PRs and doc links here when ready. :rocket:
